notes: Adds one tabbed Tags section for Rating, Archive Warnings, Categories, Fandoms, Relationships, Characters, and Additional Tags, plus a separate tabbed Stats & Metadata section for Language, Words, Chapters, Completion, Comments, Kudos, Bookmarks, and Hits. Every tag/stat group can be styled independently with flat colors, box styling, text gradients, and box gradients. Fandom is now first-class throughout preview/export/state. Inside-a-Fic preview now follows AO3 order with the upper work-action bar above metadata, then title/summary/chapters, bottom actions, kudos, comments, and footer. Chapter titles and Interface text gain separate gradient-lettering targets. Gradient Library adds the color-family shade randomizer and correct Gracebound preset (#35090B → #D8564C → #F6CF81 at 135deg). Existing CSS round-trip and per-skin state preservation carry the new controls and gradients forward.
